showrooms.reviews_source: Public review mirror emiratesbz.com/dubai/askona-258738 (Google reviews republication). Star ratings were not always published on the mirror; they are stored only when the text itself states one. Author = first name only.

reviews.author: Sharareh
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience at Askona in Festival City! Mohamed provided outstanding service, helping me find the perfect bed and mattress. The delivery was super fast, and I couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Turkan
reviews.text: Had a great time choosing a mattress, pillows and duvet for my apt! Lachyn was super helpful and actually made me try lots of options before letting me settle for one and only! As they give a warranty hence mattress will be yours forever lol.

reviews.author: Yulia
reviews.text: Amazing quality mattresses and pillows, incredibly helpful stuff, overall pleasant experience. 10 out of 10, do recommend

reviews.author: Unnamed
reviews.text: The product and support you get at the store is 5 star, unfortunately the delivery service (via Zajel courier) is 1 star. they should partner with a professional courier services company for a better customer experience

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.text: I’m very disappointed with my experience at this mattress store. They advertise a mattress with a cloud design (Teeny) both on their website and in their physical store at IKEA Festival City Mall, but after waiting three weeks for delivery, they brought a plain mattress with no design at all. When I contacted customer service, I was told that this was a new design without any prints — which is completely misleading, as it doesn’t match what they are still showing online or in-store. The staff were also quite rude and didn’t apologize or offer any solution until I specifically asked for a refund. This is false advertising and poor customer service. I wouldn’t recommend this store unless they correct their misleading product information and improve how they handle customer complaints.
